display_duration.description: Keep at 0 — this plugin never occupies display time

source_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the source LEDMatrix Pi

source_user.description: SSH username on the source Pi

source_ledmatrix_path.description: Absolute path to the LEDMatrix directory on the source Pi

ssh_key_path.description: Path to the shared SSH private key used to authenticate with the source Pi

sync_plugins.description: Sync the plugins/ directory from source

sync_config.description: Sync plugin configuration from source config.json. Hardware-specific settings (display.hardware, display.runtime) are always preserved locally.

dry_run.description: Log what would be synced without making any changes

preserve_local_keys.description: Additional top-level config.json keys to always keep from local (never overwrite from source). The following are always preserved regardless of this setting: display, schedule, dim_schedule, timezone, location, web_display_autostart, plugin_system, plugin-sync.

auto_restart.description: Automatically restart the display service when changes are detected after a sync

display_service_name.description: Name of the systemd service to restart when changes are detected
